bibliography.title: Hubble: a Model Suite to Advance the Study of LLM Memorization

abstract_sentences.text: We present Hubble, a suite of fully open-source large language models (LLMs) for the scientific study of LLM memorization.
abstract_sentences.comparison: resource scope versus no named baseline
abstract_sentences.bridge: opens with the artifact and its research purpose

evidence.anchor: We present Hubble, a suite of fully open-source large language models

abstract_sentences.text: Hubble models come in standard and perturbed variants: standard models are pretrained on a large English corpus, and perturbed models are trained in the same way but with controlled insertion of text (e.g., book passages, biographies, and test sets) designed to emulate key memorization risks.
abstract_sentences.bridge: defines the paired intervention used by later results

evidence.anchor: standard and perturbed variants ... controlled insertion of text

abstract_sentences.text: Our core release includes 8 models—standard and perturbed models with 1B or 8B parameters, pretrained on 100B or 500B tokens—establishing that memorization risks are determined by the frequency of sensitive data relative to size of the training corpus (i.e., a password appearing once in a smaller corpus is memorized better than the same password in a larger corpus).
qualifiers: relative to size of the training corpus
abstract_sentences.comparison: duplicate frequency relative to corpus size
abstract_sentences.bridge: turns the suite definition into the first empirical claim

evidence.anchor: core release includes 8 models ... 1B or 8B ... 100B or 500B tokens

abstract_sentences.text: Our release also includes 6 perturbed models with text inserted at different pretraining phases, showing that sensitive data without continued exposure can be forgotten.
abstract_sentences.bridge: adds timing and forgetting as a second intervention axis

evidence.anchor: 6 perturbed models with text inserted at different pretraining phases

abstract_sentences.text: These findings suggest two best practices for addressing memorization risks: to dilute sensitive data by increasing the size of the training corpus, and to order sensitive data to appear earlier in training.
abstract_sentences.bridge: converts the two preceding observations into recommendations

evidence.anchor: two best practices ... dilute sensitive data ... appear earlier in training

abstract_sentences.text: Beyond these general empirical findings, Hubble enables a broad range of memorization research; for example, analyzing the biographies reveals how readily different types of private information are memorized.
abstract_sentences.bridge: moves from domain-agnostic findings to a domain-specific use case

evidence.anchor: analyzing the biographies reveals how readily different types of private information are memorized

abstract_sentences.text: We also demonstrate that the randomized insertions in Hubble make it an ideal testbed for membership inference and machine unlearning, and invite the community to further explore, benchmark, and build upon our work.
abstract_sentences.comparison: membership inference and machine unlearning use cases
abstract_sentences.bridge: closes with benchmark value and an adoption invitation

evidence.anchor: randomized insertions ... ideal testbed for membership inference and machine unlearning

final_judgment.single_storyline: 受控、随机化、可公开重放的 pretraining-data intervention，把 duplicate frequency、corpus size、timing、format 和数据类型变成可分层的 memorization 研究变量，并把同一 metadata 复用于 MIA 与 unlearning。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 三类风险动机、standard/perturbed 定义、8-model core、6 timing models、三种 elicitation、Figure 1–3、Table 1、dilution/ordering 结论及 MIA/unlearning setup。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 数据统计、decontamination、训练配置、general evaluation、PII prompt、域图、timing/forgetting、MIA 全表/ROC、unlearning grid/full plots、scale/interference 图和后续讨论。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 的 before/after 机制图、Figure 2 的统一 duplicate 横轴 small multiples、Figure 3 的 desired/standard/perturbed reference points、Table 1 的逐 duplicate AUC 表格。
final_judgment.largest_gap: causal quantities、minimal interference、ideal testbed 与 policy relevance 的措辞超出明确统计设计；每条件 seed/replicate、error bars、显著性检验和 interference effect size 未报告，且部分关键证据只在附录。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 每个敏感数据干预配 matched clean reference、可审计随机 exposure metadata、明确 duplicate/timing bins、对应 metric，以及 cross-format、minimal-pair、decontamination 和 failure checks；主图把 intervention intensity 与风险/能力放在同一坐标系。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于可控制 pretraining corpus、可发布 checkpoint、可枚举插入记录的研究套件；不能直接推出闭源/商业模型、fine-tuning、自然个人数据、法律 fair-use 或完全隐私/版权消除保证。
final_judgment.body_self_sufficiency: 主文足以理解 artifact、dilution/ordering 方向和两个 benchmark；ordering、PII 异质性、ELLie 失效和完整 benchmark validity 需要附录复核。
final_judgment.theory_status: 没有 theorem、lemma、proposition、corollary、proof 或 displayed/numbered equation；经验预测由配对对照、曲线和任务拆分承载。
final_judgment.lexical_status: models、memorization、training、data、perturbations 等领域词主导正文；限定词与包装词并存，PDF H UBBLE 断词是自动词频的主要误差。

lexical_profile.interpretation: 高频词主要由真实论证动作（insert、duplicate、evaluate、compare）与领域名词驱动；fully open-source、ideal testbed、sound benchmark、best practices 是包装强度较高的短语。
